relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: A represented invoice row as recorded in billing sources with source-native identifiers and amounts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the billing invoices.json object for its invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Emit one referent per invoice_id in sources/billing/invoices.json; copy fields verbatim without renaming.

relations.name: crm_account_record
relations.meaning: A CRM account row as recorded in the CRM export with source-native account identifier.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the matching row in sources/crm.csv.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse crm.csv; one referent per crm_account_id with fields copied verbatim.

relations.name: registry_entity_record
relations.meaning: A company-registry row representing a distinct legal entity with source-native company number.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the matching row in sources/company_registry.csv.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse company_registry.csv; one referent per company_number without merging similar trade names.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: An authoritative contract or statement-of-work document identifiable by its source filename stem.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to one markdown file under sources/contracts/.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One referent per .md file; contract_id is the filename without extension.

relations.name: contract_counterparty_stated
relations.meaning: The counterparty name as stated in the contract document header, without identity normalization.
relations.grounding_contract: Grounded to the Counterparty line (or equivalent header field) in the contract markdown source.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse the stated counterparty from each contract_record header text.

relations.name: contract_term_stated
relations.meaning: A temporal or term clause excerpt quoted verbatim from a contract source without interpretive classification.
relations.grounding_contract: Grounded to the specific contract section or header lines from which the statement was extracted.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Extract effective date, expiry or end date, renewal/term language, and section texts for assignment, change-of-control, and exclusivity as raw quoted strings keyed by term_kind.

relations.name: registry_legal_name_normalized
relations.meaning: A deterministic normalization of a registry legal name for exact legal-form variant matching only.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived mechanically from the registry legal_name field with a fixed normalization rule; no semantic merge beyond legal-form variants.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Apply a fixed case-folding and legal-suffix normalization (Ltd/Limited, Inc/Incorporated, GmbH, LLC) to each registry_entity_record legal_name.

relations.name: source_native_identifier
relations.meaning: The canonical source-native identifier string for a referent in the crm:, billing:, registry:, or contract: namespaces.
relations.grounding_contract: Deterministic mapping from compiled referents to purpose identifier forms; no semantic renaming.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Derive identifier strings per purpose B identifier forms from invoice_record, crm_account_record, registry_entity_record, and contract_record.

relations.name: invoice_is_open
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice status field records it as open per billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Boolean derived solely from invoice_record.status equal to the source token open.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT from invoice_record where status is compared literally to open.

relations.name: contract_is_expired
relations.meaning: Whether a contract or statement of work is expired as grounded by an explicit expiry date or non-renewal statement in contract sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_term_stated expiry or end-date facts; contracts without explicit expiry evidence are not marked expired by default.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Parse stated expiry/end dates from contract_term_stated; set is_expired true only when a grounded expiry date is before the compile reference date or the source states non-renewal/expiry.

relations.name: identity_judgment_candidate
relations.meaning: A directed pair of source-native identifiers that may require an identity judgment to connect commercially relevant records.
relations.grounding_contract: Each candidate pair must cite the mechanical linkage rule that generated it (shared VAT, normalized registry name match, CRM-to-billing thread, contract counterparty to CRM/billing/registry).
relations.construction_rule: C4: Generate pairs needed to connect each commercially relevant CRM account to its billed names, governing contract identifier, and registry rows that are mechanical name or VAT candidates.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit left/right in source_native_identifier form; include CRM↔billing, CRM↔contract, CRM↔registry, billing↔contract, billing↔registry, and contract↔registry pairs required for connectivity per purpose B policies.

relations.name: invoice_contract_link_candidate
relations.meaning: A candidate invoice-to-contract pair drawn from shared commercial threads without asserting governance.
relations.grounding_contract: Each pair cites the mechanical basis (shared billed name thread, explicit commercial note reference, or identity-linked counterparty path).
relations.construction_rule: C4: Cross invoice_record billed names with contract_record counterparties linked through identity_judgment_candidate paths and authoritative commercial_notes references.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per invoice paired with each contract reachable through a CRM or billing commercial thread or explicit note linkage.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two referents denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: C3: For each identity_judgment_candidate, resolve with ACCEPT/REJECT/UNRESOLVED mapped to SAME_ENTITY/DISTINCT/UNRESOLVED; ground every persistent assertion.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether two source-native counterparty identifiers denote the same legal entity, are confidently distinct, or lack sufficient evidence.

relations.name: clause_presence_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether a contract source contains, lacks, or only ambiguously supports a specific grounded clause kind.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet quoting the contract section or explicit absence after review; ABSENT requires grounded negative finding in the contract text, not default absence.
relations.construction_rule: C3: For each contract_record and applicable clause_kind, classify contract_term_stated excerpts and full contract text into PRESENT, ABSENT, or UNRESOLVED.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_record, emit one candidate per clause_kind in the union of purpose A acquisition kinds and purpose C obligation kinds.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract text clearly contains, clearly lacks, or only ambiguously addresses the named clause kind.

relations.name: invoice_contract_link_judgment
relations.meaning: Whether an invoice is governed by a specific contract based on grounded commercial linkage evidence.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet citing billing, contract, identity, or commercial_notes evidence; missing linkage evidence is not a negative finding.
relations.construction_rule: C3: For each invoice_contract_link_candidate, resolve LINKED or UNRESOLVED with grounded evidence; do not assert linkage from name similarity alone.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the invoice commercially belongs to the contract relationship with confident evidence.

relations.name: purpose_a_revenue_exposure_row
relations.meaning: A purpose A output row for an invoice that passes active-contract and acquisition-relevant-clause filters with association disposition.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from world relations plus purpose A policies in 00_intention_contract.json and contracts/purpose_a.json; not persisted as world truth.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Include invoice when governing contract is not expired under purpose active-contract policy, has at least one acquisition-relevant clause_kind PRESENT per purpose A taxonomy, and map identity/link evidence to association asserted or unresolved.

relations.name: purpose_c_dependency_row
relations.meaning: A purpose C output row assessing commercial dependency for a counterparty-contract pair under purpose-defined relationship and obligation criteria.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from world relations plus purpose C policies; unresolved identity forces status unresolved rather than dependent=false.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Emit dependent when current commercial relationship holds (open invoice or non-expired contract with auto_renewal or rolling_term PRESENT) and at least one obligation_kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} is PRESENT; otherwise unresolved when identity or linkage blocks assessment.
